name: mdx-twin-capability-registry
human_line: Everything Twin is made of, declared in one place: what it may offer to do, the guards before and after the model, the prompt layers it composes, how questions route, and the slots not built yet.

switch_groups.title: What Twin can offer to do
switch_groups.cue: Each is a proposal only - nothing runs without your approval, and approvals ride the same governed writes as doing it by hand.

switch_groups.title: Before the model sees a message
switch_groups.cue: Deterministic checks, no model in the loop. A held message was never sent and never saved - the conversation says so plainly.

switch_groups.title: After the model answers
switch_groups.cue: Corrections land in the saved record, and the display follows. Nothing here ever blocks an answer.

capabilities.ui_line: offers to save a decision to #decisions
capabilities.human_description: When a real decision with reasoning emerges, Twin offers to record it for the company record. You approve first; the record rides the same governed message write as doing it by hand.

capabilities.ui_line: offers to post a summary to the team room
capabilities.human_description: When thinking seems ready to socialize, Twin offers a short post to the team room in your voice. You approve first; the post rides the governed message write.

capabilities.ui_line: offers next questions as tappable chips
capabilities.human_description: After answering, Twin may offer up to three natural next questions as chips that prefill the composer. Nothing is saved; tapping one only types it for you.

capabilities.ui_line: offers to save a draft to Pages, or download it
capabilities.human_description: When you ask Twin to write or draft something as a document, it offers a titled draft. You approve before it is saved to Pages, where it becomes a page you can read (the same governed write as publishing it by hand), and you can download it instead. The draft text becomes company record only through the approved write.

capabilities.ui_line: holds back attempts to rewrite the model's instructions
capabilities.human_description: Plain pattern matching, sub-millisecond, never a model judging a model. A held message was never sent to the provider and never saved.

capabilities.ui_line: holds back messages over 10,000 characters
capabilities.human_description: Messages over the cap are held before the provider call with a plain explanation, never silently truncated.

capabilities.ui_line: emails, SSNs, and keys never persist in an answer
capabilities.human_description: Redaction lands in the saved record with a correction event, so what you see matches what was kept. Never blocks an answer.

capabilities.ui_line: counts chatbot-speak phrases, shown quietly per answer
capabilities.human_description: v1's AI-speak detector: counts drift phrases and shows the count quietly in provenance. Observation only, never a block.

capabilities.ui_line: who Twin is before anything else
capabilities.human_description: The base layer every companion shares: grounded in the company's own record, honest about being a model, never customer-service voice.

capabilities.ui_line: how Twin talks: speech over writing, the unpack pattern, no em dashes
capabilities.human_description: v1's voice rules carried forward: react first, talk like speech, unpack one idea at a time.

capabilities.ui_line: the built-in specialists' own shapes
capabilities.human_description: Each built-in companion adds its own layer over the foundation: advisor, architect, coach, coder, compliance, problem solver.

capabilities.ui_line: personas you define ride the same slot
capabilities.human_description: A custom companion's context replaces the built-in layer for that turn. Prompt-only, capped, never stored in receipts.

capabilities.ui_line: how you like to be answered, from the You page
capabilities.human_description: Role, register, and style from this machine's You profile ride each question as a prompt layer. The derived persona id is recorded; the raw text never is.

capabilities.ui_line: when two specialists answer, each takes only its lane
capabilities.human_description: On panel questions each specialist is told who else is answering and to take only its own lane - the instruction is part of the recorded ask.

capabilities.ui_line: a live snapshot of the other surfaces, so Twin can answer what is going on
capabilities.human_description: A snapshot of what is moving across MDx (review queue, Forge runs, latest Message, Pages) read from real projections and relayed with the question so Twin can ground an answer in company state. Prompt-only, capped, disclosed by presence; the lines are never written to receipts.

capabilities.ui_line: Twin reasons over a file you bring into the conversation
capabilities.human_description: When the person attaches a document, its text rides with the question as a prompt layer so Twin can reason over it and cite it. Prompt-only, capped, disclosed by presence; the contents are never written to receipts. Sensitivity routing decides which model may read it - a document marked sensitive only goes to a sovereign model.

capabilities.ui_line: the saved conversation rides the live call
capabilities.human_description: Prior live turns are read back from the kernel's own receipts - receipts are the memory, no shadow store. Capped at 12 turns and 2,000 characters.

capabilities.ui_line: each question goes to the right specialist, instantly
capabilities.human_description: v1's keyword router, client-side and deterministic - no model call, no latency. An explicit pick always wins over Auto.

capabilities.ui_line: two specialists answer together when a question spans domains
capabilities.human_description: When a second domain scores close enough, both specialists stream concurrently as separate recorded turns.

capabilities.ui_line: not built yet - lights up when its contract lands
capabilities.human_description: External connectors arrive as deliberate kernel contracts with their own receipts and admin controls. This slot is declared so the surface lights up with zero rework.

capabilities.ui_line: not built yet - lights up when its contract lands
capabilities.human_description: External connectors arrive as deliberate kernel contracts with their own receipts and admin controls. This slot is declared so the surface lights up with zero rework.

kind_notes.hook: Guards are the two lifecycle hooks that exist today (before the provider call, after the completed answer). A general hook rail is deliberately not built until a real consumer exists - connectors will be that moment.
kind_notes.plugin: Bundles of prompts, skills, and connectors. None declared yet; the kind is reserved so bundles arrive as data, not architecture.
